hero.name: Mahmoud Ahmed Mobarak 8890i0
hero.subtitle: A Year 10 Student at The Westminster School, Dubai
bashLines: I am a high-achieving student passionate about learning, innovation, and excellence. I enjoy tackling complex challenges, exploring new ideas, and applying knowledge practically in projects and real-life applications.
I constantly strive to grow academically, personally, and creatively, whether through coding, engineering, robotics, chess, or pursuing aerospace and aviation interests.
I am driven by curiosity, discipline, and a commitment to develop both my technical skills and leadership capabilities.
Beyond academics, I enjoy engaging in extracurricular activities like football, solving puzzles, and creating innovative projects that expand my skillset and understanding of the world.
My ultimate goal is to combine creativity, technical mastery, and personal growth to excel in multiple fields including Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, and Aviation.

projects.title: House Price Predictor
projects.description: A machine learning project built with Python and Scikit-Learn that predicts house prices based on various features such as location, size, and amenities.
projects.fullTitle: House Price Predictor: ML Regression Model
points: Built a machine learning model with Python and Scikit-Learn that predicts house prices from features like location, size, and amenities.
Cleaned and engineered real housing datasets to improve prediction accuracy.
Evaluated multiple regression algorithms and selected the strongest performer.

projects.title: Cat vs Dog Classifier
projects.description: A deep learning computer vision model built using TensorFlow and Keras to classify images of cats and dogs with high accuracy.
projects.fullTitle: Cat vs Dog Classifier: Deep Learning Vision
points: Developed a computer vision model using TensorFlow and Keras to classify images of cats and dogs with high accuracy.
Trained convolutional neural networks with data augmentation for robust results.
Processed and prepared hundreds of labeled training images.

projects.title: Liver Cancer Predictor
projects.description: A healthcare AI project using machine learning algorithms to assist in the early prediction and classification of liver cancer from patient data.
points: Created a healthcare AI project using machine learning to assist early prediction and classification of liver cancer from patient data.
Focused on responsible, data-driven decision support for medical screening.
Compared multiple classification algorithms to find the most reliable results.

projects.title: Mahmoud Mobarak Portfolio
projects.description: A fully responsive personal portfolio website built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to showcase my academic achievements, projects, certifications, and extracurricular activities.
points: Designed and built a fully responsive personal portfolio using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Includes custom creations: a 3D flip book, animated wallet cards, and an interactive hierarchy diagram.
Runs as a fully static site with a local admin panel for easy content management.

projects.title: Homemade Water Filter
projects.description: Designed and built a working homemade water filter using layered natural materials to demonstrate basic water purification principles.
points: Designed and built a working water filter using layered household materials.
Tested filtration effectiveness across multiple design iterations.
Applied engineering design thinking to a real-world sustainability problem.

projects.title: Solar Panel Model
projects.description: A hands-on engineering project demonstrating clean energy conversion using solar cells, exploring renewable energy principles.
points: Constructed a working solar panel model demonstrating renewable energy conversion.
Measured and compared energy output under different light conditions.
Presented the project at a school science exhibition.

projects.title: Lingua Mystica
projects.description: An interactive ancient script decoder and linguistic exploration tool exploring cipher systems and historic writing methods.
points: Created a language-learning concept exploring creative approaches to mastering new languages.
Combined spaced repetition with gamified practice techniques.
Designed the user experience and learning flow from scratch.

projects.title: KeyCraft E-commerce
projects.description: A modern, responsive e-commerce web concept for custom keychains with cart functionality and interactive product catalog.
points: Built an e-commerce concept store around keyboard products with a modern storefront.
Designed product pages, cart flow, and fully responsive layouts.
Focused on clean UI and conversion-friendly design patterns.

extracurriculars.title: Robotics Program - FLL
extracurriculars.description: As an active member of the school's First LEGO League (FLL) robotics team, I spend the season designing, building, and programming autonomous LEGO robots. Beyond the robot itself, I work on the innovation project side — researching real-world problems and pitching creative solutions to judges. The program has taught me how engineering, coding, and teamwork come together under real competition pressure.
extracurriculars.lead: Where code meets creation — building robots that think.
points: Programmed autonomous robots using sensor-based navigation and mission strategy.
Collaborated with teammates to brainstorm, prototype, and test robot designs across the season.
Presented our innovation project and robot design directly to FLL judges.
Learned to stay calm and iterate fast when missions fail mid-competition.

extracurriculars.title: Physics Exhibition
extracurriculars.description: At the school Physics Exhibition, I designed and presented working scientific models that demonstrate core physical principles — turning textbook theory into something visitors can see, touch, and question. Explaining complex ideas to audiences of every age sharpened my ability to communicate science clearly and confidently.
extracurriculars.lead: Turning abstract equations into experiments people can touch.
points: Built interactive demonstration models explaining core physics principles.
Presented to hundreds of visiting students and faculty across the exhibition.
Answered spontaneous deep-dive questions from teachers and judges.
Translated abstract equations into visual, hands-on experiences.

extracurriculars.title: Organic Expo
extracurriculars.description: Representing sustainable thinking at the Organic Expo, I presented eco-friendly innovations and organic solutions to industry visitors and judges. The expo pushed me to think about how engineering choices affect the environment, and how small design decisions can make products dramatically more sustainable.
extracurriculars.lead: Innovation with a conscience — engineering for a greener future.
points: Presented sustainable innovations to industry visitors and expo judges.
Researched the eco-friendly materials and processes behind our showcased solutions.
Discussed real-world sustainability trade-offs with professionals.
Represented the school at a public-facing environmental event.

extracurriculars.title: Globex Competition
extracurriculars.description: At the Globex competition, I presented a homemade water filter built from layered natural and household materials, demonstrating how basic engineering design can tackle real water-purification problems. The project earned 2nd place and taught me how to take an idea from rough prototype to a judged, professional presentation.
extracurriculars.lead: From a homemade filter to a judged engineering stage.
points: Designed and built a layered water filter demonstrating real purification principles.
Earned 2nd place among competitive STEM project entries.
Explained filtration science and design iterations to the judging panel.
Took a project from concept to prototype to tested to presented.
